subject: privilege: fix `auth_socket` bug, should only allow os user name to login (#54032)
summary: Fixes an auth_socket authentication bypass where empty `authentication_string` could skip socket-user verification, allowing any local OS user to authenticate as an auth_socket TiDB user. The socket-user check now runs unconditionally for `AuthSocket`, enforcing 1:1 mapping (or `AS 'sockuser'` mapping) regardless of whether `authentication_string` is empty; adds targeted server-side test coverage with a test-only OS-user mock.
